result.topic_en: Euler derives the total moment of the elementary forces on a vibrating elastic lamina, shows it balances the elastic moment, and determines the force F that the support at end B must sustain for equilibrium.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 477
$\int dx\int p\,dx = -Kcc.\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\cos.\Phi - B\sin.\Phi + Ce^{\Phi} + De^{-\Phi})$
$+Kcc.\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A + C + D)$
$+Kcc.\frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t(-B + C - D)\,x$
quibus formulis in ſequentibus plurimum vtemur. Interim hic notaſſe iuuabit, ſi ad illud momentum addatur momentum vis E quod eſt
$= Ex = -Kcc.\frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t(-B+C-D)x$, tum ob
$-A + C + D = 0$
totum momentum fore
$= -Kcc.\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\cos.\Phi - B\sin.\Phi + Ce^{\Phi} + De^{-\Phi})$
cui momentum elaſticitatis negatiue ſumtum praeciſe eſt aequale, vti rei natura poſtulat. Promoueamus nunc punctum Y vsque ad alterum terminum B, faciendo $x = a$ ſeu $\frac{\theta a}{b} = \zeta$ vti ſupra et ſumma omnium virium elementarium vna cum vi ſtyli E erit
$= -Kcc.\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\cos.\zeta - B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta})$
quae cum vi quam ſtylus $B\beta$ ſuſtinet, quae ſit $Bf = F$ euaneſcere debet, propterea quod omnes has vires in aequilibrio conſiſtere oportet, vnde etiam vis iſta $Bf$ innoteſcit, erit enim
$F = +Kcc.\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\cos.\zeta - B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta})$.
Porro quum terminus B a ſola hac vi retineatur, cuius momentum pro puncto B eſt nullum, hic etiam nulla curuatura locum habere poteſt, vnde totum iſtud momentum ad terminum B translatum,
Ooo 3 facien-

items.quote: cui momentum elaſticitatis negatiue ſumtum praeciſe eſt aequale, vti rei natura poſtulat.
items.english: to which the moment of elasticity taken negatively is precisely equal, as the nature of the matter requires.

items.quote: quae cum vi quam ſtylus $B\beta$ ſuſtinet, quae ſit $Bf = F$ euaneſcere debet, propterea quod omnes has vires in aequilibrio conſiſtere oportet
items.english: which together with the force that the support Bβ sustains, let it be Bf = F, must vanish, because all these forces must be in equilibrium

items.quote: Porro quum terminus B a ſola hac vi retineatur, cuius momentum pro puncto B eſt nullum, hic etiam nulla curuatura locum habere poteſt
items.english: Further, since the end B is held by this force alone, whose moment about point B is zero, no curvature can occur there either
